notes:
What's new in 0.36.0 — Smoother menus

• Moving around Home, Discover and My Lists is much quicker on every device.
• Every row is now the same size, so the page no longer jumps as you move between rows.
• The title you're on opens into its wide picture once you stop on it, so scrolling along a row stays quick.
• Trailers wait a moment longer before they start: just under a second on a row, a second and a half in the featured title.
• A smaller, faster app: the download is about a third of the size it was.
